page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: fuit, longissimè procurrens cum pago proximo Helpenâ, qui vi i i stadiis non minus ab urbe recessit, continuâ domorum serie penè se conjunxit. Et præter suburbia hæc totoMeridionali & Septemtrionali latere in eodem dorso editiore, in quo urbs est sita, amœnis ac sumptuosis hortis, & ædificiis elegantibus totus post pomœria locus longè lateque obsitus ac contectus fuit. Taceo insulas virorum nobilium complures in Meridionali potissimùm plaga. Cuncta nunc per bellum vastata, vix pauca hic illic instaurata: in Borea verò plagâ urbis novæ mœnia illa magnifica ac firma, de quibus paulò antè dixi, excitata, sed nondum perfecta. Commoditas[?] situs.Denique urbis situs in univer-sum hujusmodi, ut quemadmodum per amnes, ac rivos, quos dixi, ex Amaso fl. ac Lavicæ ostio, ipsoque adeò mari, itemque ex agro circumjecto, majoribus minoribusque navigiis, sic per Drentiæ itinera nullo non anni tempore idonea, ex ipsa Drentia & cæteris circumjectis Germaniæ partibus rhedis ac curribus percommodè res omnes impor-

page.notes: Running head and page number are at the top; the catchword "tari" is at the bottom right. The left-margin note "Commodi tas situs." is split across two lines in the scan; the hyphen position is unclear, so I read it as "Commoditas" with [?]. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "sumptuosis" has an accent or mark over the o that I could not confirm, so I left it plain. Some letters in "Helpenâ" and "verò" carry diacritics as printed. Paragraph breaks are not clearly marked by indents on this page, so the text is one continuous paragraph.
